finding.headline: "The Paced-Bottle Newbie"
finding.problem: "He takes the bottle so fast then won't come back to me. I'm accidentally pushing him away from breastfeeding and I don't know how to slow it down."
finding.recurring_situation: EMOTIONAL (feeling like BF is failing · pressure · guilt · exhaustion)
finding.person: A 28-yr-old mixed-feeding mum who hands the bottle upright and fast; baby gulps, then refuses the breast (flow preference).

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Module inside B1 / Marketing angle — "Paced Bottle 101: Protect the Breast, Beat Flow-Preference."". Verdict: PASSES (18/25)..
